answer.text: Average absolute difference between portfolio and benchmark returns
Standard deviation of differential returns (Rp - Rb)

explanation.text: The Logic: Tracking Error = σ(Rp - Rb) = standard deviation of the return difference between portfolio and benchmark. The Trap: Average difference is 'active return'; TE is about volatility of the difference. Cross-Exam Context: Core performance metric. Manager's Pro-Tip: Passive funds target TE < 50 bps; active funds routinely have TE of 3-8%. Annualize appropriately.
